# Tinplate Labs

> Small, reliable tools for AI agents and developers. Apify Actors return structured JSON, charge per result (failed items are free), process data inside the caller's own run with no LLM and no telemetry, and can be called by agents through the Apify MCP server (https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=tinplatelabs/<actor-name>) or the Apify API (POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/tinplatelabs~<actor-name>/run-sync-get-dataset-items).

## Apify Actors

- [Document to Markdown](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/document-to-markdown/): PDF to Markdown converter: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, CSV and scanned images to clean Markdown or JSON for LLMs, RAG and AI agents. Tables and headings kept, OCR only where needed. $0.002 per page. Store: https://apify.com/tinplatelabs/document-to-markdown
- [Domain Intel](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/domain-intel/): Bulk WHOIS (RDAP), DNS, SPF/DMARC/DKIM and SSL certificate checker: one graded verdict per domain with registrar, expiry dates, findings and fixes. $0.003 per domain. Store: https://apify.com/tinplatelabs/domain-intel
- [Contact Normalizer](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/contact-normalizer/): Phone number validator and e-mail cleaner: phones to E.164 with type and region, e-mails checked for syntax, disposable and role accounts, names and countries tidied, duplicates found. Offline, $0.0005 per record. Store: https://apify.com/tinplatelabs/contact-normalizer
- [Image Upscaler](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/image-upscaler/): AI image upscaler: upscale product photos, thumbnails and scans 2x, 3x or 4x in bulk with Real-ESRGAN, sharper without invented faces or text. PNG/JPEG/WebP out, transparency kept. From $0.012 per image. Store: https://apify.com/tinplatelabs/image-upscaler
- [Site Discovery](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/site-discovery/): Sitemap extractor: every URL from a site's sitemaps (indexes, gzip, nested), robots.txt access for AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended) and llms.txt. $0.002 per site. Store: https://apify.com/tinplatelabs/site-discovery
- [HTTP Request & Bulk API Calls](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/agent-http/): Send HTTP requests and bulk API calls (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE): extract JSON fields into columns, HTML as Markdown, retries, redirects, timing and SSRF protection. For Clay, n8n, Make and AI agents. $0.001 per request. Store: https://apify.com/tinplatelabs/agent-http
- [Dataset Toolkit](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/dataset-toolkit/): Merge and deduplicate Apify datasets and CSV, JSON, Excel or Parquet files, output only new items since the last run, filter, sort and export to CSV, XLSX, JSON or Parquet. $0.002 per 1,000 rows. Store: https://apify.com/tinplatelabs/dataset-toolkit
- [Image OCR](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/image-ocr/): Extract text from screenshots, scans, receipts and photos in reading order, as text and Markdown, with every line and word's bounding box and confidence. PaddleOCR. $0.003 per image. Store: https://apify.com/tinplatelabs/image-ocr
- [Transcriber](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/transcriber/): Transcribe your audio and video files with Whisper: full text, timestamped segments, speaker labels (diarization), language detection, translation to English and SRT/WebVTT subtitles. From $0.007 per minute. Store: https://apify.com/tinplatelabs/transcriber
- [Video Frames](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/video-frames/): Extract frames from your videos every N seconds, N evenly spaced, at exact timestamps, keyframes or scene changes, plus a best-thumbnail pick and contact sheets. JPEG, PNG or WebP. $0.002 per frame. Store: https://apify.com/tinplatelabs/video-frames

## JetBrains plugin

- [Traefik Labels](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/traefik-labels/): JetBrains IDE plugin for Traefik Docker labels in Compose files: completion, unknown-label warnings with quick-fixes and hover docs, generated from Traefik's label reference. Free. Marketplace: https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/34986-traefik-labels

## Optional

- [Privacy](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/privacy/): no cookies or tracking; per-tool data handling
- [EULA](https://tinplatelabs.github.io/legal/EULA): license for marketplace-distributed software
